bbq-sausage-loaded-potatoes.title: BBQ Sausage Loaded Potatoes
bbq-sausage-loaded-potatoes.subtitle: Crispy potatoes with BBQ sausages

method.title: Preheat and toss
method.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (200°C fan) or air fryer to 200°C. Toss potatoes with oil, paprika, salt and pepper.

method.title: Roast potatoes
method.text: Spread on a baking tray and roast 20–25 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and crispy.

method.title: Cook sausages
method.text: Heat a frying pan over medium heat. Cook sausages 8–10 minutes until browned and cooked through, then slice.

method.title: Assemble and melt
method.text: Top potatoes with sliced sausages and grated cheddar. Return to the oven 2–3 minutes until cheese is melted.

method.title: Finish and serve
method.text: Drizzle with BBQ sauce, add a dollop of sour cream or mayo and sprinkle over spring onions. Serve immediately.

bbq-sausage-loaded-potatoes.tip: Add jalapeños or use mozzarella instead of cheddar for a different twist.

buffalo-chicken-quesadillas.title: Buffalo Chicken Quesadillas
buffalo-chicken-quesadillas.subtitle: Spicy, cheesy and ready in 20 minutes!

method.title: prep chicken
method.text: Trim and cut chicken into small pieces, season with salt, pepper and a little garlic powder.

method.title: cook chicken
method.text: Cook chicken in a pan over medium heat until cooked through and no longer pink, 5–7 minutes.

method.title: make filling
method.text: Mix cooked chicken with hot sauce and cream cheese until creamy, then stir in some chopped red onion.

method.title: assemble quesadillas
method.text: Spread filling and a sprinkle of cheese on a tortilla, top with another tortilla and press to seal.

method.title: cook & serve
method.text: Cook 2–3 minutes each side in a dry pan until golden and cheese melts. Slice, drizzle with ranch and scatter coriander.

buffalo-chicken-quesadillas.tip: Use leftover or rotisserie chicken to cut prep time.

cheesy-bbq-chicken-loaded-fries.title: Cheesy BBQ Loaded Fries
cheesy-bbq-chicken-loaded-fries.subtitle: Crispy fries topped with BBQ chicken

method.title: Cook fries
method.text: Cook the fries according to pack instructions until golden and crispy.

method.title: Season chicken
method.text: Toss shredded chicken with smoked paprika, garlic granules, oil and 2 tbsp BBQ sauce.

method.title: Assemble fries
method.text: Pile cooked fries into an ovenproof dish and top with the BBQ chicken.

method.title: Melt cheese
method.text: Scatter both cheeses over the chicken then bake or grill a few minutes until melted.

method.title: Finish & serve
method.text: Drizzle remaining BBQ sauce, dollop sour cream and scatter spring onions and crispy onions.

cheesy-bbq-chicken-loaded-fries.tip: Add sliced jalapeños for heat and an extra drizzle of BBQ sauce if you like it saucy.

cheesy-bbq-loaded-potatoes.title: Cheesy BBQ Loaded Potatoes
cheesy-bbq-loaded-potatoes.subtitle: with chicken & crispy onions

method.title: prepare potatoes
method.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Rub potatoes with oil, season and bake 35–45 minutes until soft.

method.title: mix chicken
method.text: Combine shredded chicken with 2 tbsp BBQ sauce in a bowl.

method.title: open potatoes
method.text: Slice open baked potatoes and fluff the centres with a fork.

method.title: top and melt
method.text: Fill each potato with BBQ chicken, spoon over remaining sauce and sprinkle with cheddar. Bake 5 minutes.

method.title: finish & serve
method.text: Top with red onion, crispy onions, spring onions and a dollop of mayo or sour cream. Serve hot.

cheesy-bbq-loaded-potatoes.tip: Swap chicken for leftover pulled pork or beans for a cheaper twist.

cheesy-bbq-pulled-chicken-nachos.title: Cheesy BBQ Pulled Chicken Nachos
cheesy-bbq-pulled-chicken-nachos.subtitle: Loaded, gooey sharing nachos

method.title: Preheat oven
method.text: Heat oven to 200°C/fan 180°C/gas 6.

method.title: Layer chips
method.text: Spread tortilla chips in an even layer on a large ovenproof dish or baking tray.

method.title: Add toppings
method.text: Toss pulled chicken with half the BBQ sauce, then scatter over the chips with onion and sweetcorn.

method.title: Add cheese
method.text: Scatter grated cheddar and pieces of mozzarella evenly over the nachos.

method.title: Bake and finish
method.text: Bake 8–10 mins until cheese melts. Drizzle remaining BBQ sauce, dollop sour cream and sprinkle spring onions.

cheesy-bbq-pulled-chicken-nachos.tip: Warm the chicken in BBQ sauce beforehand for extra flavour and faster assembly.

cheesy-beef-bean-loaded-potatoes.title: Cheesy Beef & Bean Loaded Potatoes
cheesy-beef-bean-loaded-potatoes.subtitle: Hearty cheesy loaded spuds

method.title: Bake potatoes
method.text: Cook in a preheated oven at 200°C for 60–70 mins, or microwave until soft and fluffy through.

method.title: Cook mince
method.text: Heat a little oil, fry the chopped onion 3–4 mins until soft, then add mince and brown well.

method.title: Add flavour
method.text: Stir in paprika, beans and tomato sauce or salsa. Simmer 5–10 mins until thickened. Season to taste.

method.title: Prep potatoes
method.text: Split the baked potatoes and use a fork to fluff up the centres.

method.title: Assemble & serve
method.text: Spoon over the beef and bean mix, top with grated cheese and scatter spring onion if using. Serve hot.

cheesy-beef-bean-loaded-potatoes.tip: Pop under the grill for a minute to make the cheese extra bubbly.

cheesy-beef-pepper-stuffed-flatbreads.title: Cheesy Beef & Pepper Stuffed Flatbreads
cheesy-beef-pepper-stuffed-flatbreads.subtitle: Crispy outside. Cheesy inside. Proper tasty!

method.title: Brown the beef
method.text: Heat a large frying pan over medium-high. Cook beef mince until browned, breaking it up. Drain excess fat if needed.

method.title: Cook the veg
method.text: Add chopped onion and peppers and cook 4–5 minutes until softened. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.

method.title: Season the mix
method.text: Stir in tomato purée, paprika, mixed herbs, salt and pepper. Cook 2–3 minutes until well combined.

method.title: Assemble flatbreads
method.text: Lay out flatbreads, pile beef mixture over one half of each, sprinkle with cheddar and fold to close.

method.title: Cook and serve
method.text: Heat a clean frying pan over medium. Cook 2–3 minutes per side until golden and cheese has melted. Slice and serve.

cheesy-beef-pepper-stuffed-flatbreads.tip: Add chilli flakes for a kick or swap the beef for chicken.

cheesy-beef-taco-pasta.title: Cheesy Beef Taco Pasta
cheesy-beef-taco-pasta.subtitle: Quick cheesy midweek pasta

method.title: Cook the pasta
method.text: Boil pasta in salted water according to the packet. Drain and set aside.

method.title: Sweat the onion
method.text: Heat oil in a large frying pan, add the onion and cook 2–3 minutes until softened.

method.title: Brown the mince
method.text: Add garlic and beef mince. Cook, breaking up, until browned, about 5–6 minutes.

method.title: Make the sauce
method.text: Stir in taco seasoning, tomato puree and chopped tomatoes. Simmer for 5 minutes.

method.title: Combine and serve
method.text: Stir in pasta and most cheese until heated. Top with remaining cheese and garnish to serve.

cheesy-beef-taco-pasta.tip: Use any short pasta. Add frozen sweetcorn or beans for extra veg and value.

cheesy-buffalo-chicken-potato-skins.title: Cheesy Buffalo Chicken Potato Skins
cheesy-buffalo-chicken-potato-skins.subtitle: Crispy, cheesy and spicy

method.title: Bake potatoes
method.text: Scrub, prick and bake potatoes at 200°C (fan) for 50–60 minutes until soft.

method.title: Cook chicken
method.text: Cut chicken into small pieces, season with garlic powder, paprika and mixed herbs and fry in a little oil 6–8 minutes.

method.title: Make sauce
method.text: Lower the heat, add hot sauce and a few tablespoons of soft cheese and stir until chicken is coated and sauce is creamy.

method.title: Prepare skins
method.text: Halve potatoes lengthways, scoop out a little flesh leaving a thin layer and mash scooped potato to mix with chicken if you like.

method.title: Fill and bake
method.text: Spoon buffalo chicken into skins, top with grated cheddar and bake at 200°C for 10–15 minutes. Finish with spring onions and extra sauce.

cheesy-buffalo-chicken-potato-skins.tip: Use leftover potato filling to make loaded cheesy mash.

cheesy-cajun-chicken-wraps.title: Cheesy Cajun Chicken Wraps
cheesy-cajun-chicken-wraps.subtitle: Spiced chicken with melty cheddar

method.title: Season chicken
method.text: Toss the chicken with Cajun seasoning, salt, pepper and olive oil until evenly coated.

method.title: Cook chicken
method.text: Pan-fry the chicken in a hot pan for 6–8 minutes until golden and cooked through; set aside.

method.title: Sauté veg
method.text: In the same pan, soften the onion and both peppers for 3–4 minutes until slightly charred.

method.title: Make sauce
method.text: Mix the soft cheese or mayonnaise with garlic powder. Fill each wrap with lettuce, chicken, peppers and cheese, then drizzle with sauce.

method.title: Toast wraps
method.text: Fold the wraps and toast in a dry pan 1–2 minutes per side until golden and the cheese has melted.

cheesy-cajun-chicken-wraps.tip: Cook chicken and peppers ahead, then assemble and toast for a speedy meal.

cheesy-cajun-sausage-gnocchi.title: Cheesy Cajun Sausage Gnocchi
cheesy-cajun-sausage-gnocchi.subtitle: Creamy, spicy and ready in 20 minutes!

method.title: Brown sausages
method.text: Slice sausages into bite-sized pieces. Fry in a large pan over medium-high heat until browned, then remove.

method.title: Fry veg
method.text: Add a little oil to the same pan and fry the onion and peppers 5–6 minutes until softened, then add garlic and Cajun seasoning for 1 minute.

method.title: Crisp gnocchi
method.text: Add the gnocchi and cook 3–4 minutes, stirring, until lightly golden and slightly crispy.

method.title: Stir cream & spinach
method.text: Pour in the single cream, simmer 2–3 minutes. Return the sausages and add the spinach, stirring until wilted.

method.title: Add cheese & serve
method.text: Stir in most of the grated cheese until melted. Top with the remaining cheese and a sprinkle of extra Cajun seasoning to serve.

cheesy-cajun-sausage-gnocchi.tip: Add a squeeze of lemon at the end for extra flavour.

cheesy-pepperoni-pizza-wraps.title: Cheesy Pepperoni Pizza Wraps
cheesy-pepperoni-pizza-wraps.subtitle: Crispy, cheesy pizza pockets

method.title: Prepare wraps
method.text: Spread 1–2 tbsp pizza sauce over each tortilla, leaving a 1cm border.

method.title: Add toppings
method.text: Scatter most of the mozzarella and cheddar, top with pepperoni, mixed herbs, garlic granules and black pepper.

method.title: Cook wraps
method.text: Fold or roll each tortilla to enclose the filling. Cook seam-side down in a dry frying pan over medium heat 2–3 mins each side.

method.title: Serve hot
method.text: Cut wraps in half, scatter basil or parsley if using and serve immediately.

cheesy-pepperoni-pizza-wraps.tip: Warm tortillas briefly before rolling to stop them splitting and to help them crisp in the pan.

cheesy-taco-quesadillas.title: Cheesy Taco Quesadillas
cheesy-taco-quesadillas.subtitle: Simple ingredients. Huge flavour.

method.title: Cook veg and beef
method.text: Fry the onion and pepper for 3–4 mins, add beef and cook until browned.

method.title: Add seasoning
method.text: Drain excess fat, stir in taco seasoning with a splash of water and simmer briefly.

method.title: Fill tortillas
method.text: Scatter cheese and the beef mix over half of each tortilla, fold to enclose.

method.title: Toast quesadillas
method.text: Cook in a dry pan 2–3 mins per side until golden and cheese has melted. Slice and serve.

cheesy-taco-quesadillas.tip: Cook low and slow if your pan browns too quickly so the cheese fully melts.

cheesy-taco-rice-skillet.title: Cheesy Taco Rice Skillet
cheesy-taco-rice-skillet.subtitle: Quick, cheap and packed with flavour!

method.title: Cook the beef
method.text: Heat a large skillet over medium. Add beef mince and cook until browned, then drain excess fat.

method.title: Cook the veg
method.text: Add chopped onion, bell pepper and garlic to the skillet and cook 3–4 minutes until softened.

method.title: Add spices & tins
method.text: Stir in taco seasoning, diced tomatoes, black beans, sweetcorn and the rice. Mix to combine.

method.title: Simmer the rice
method.text: Add 480ml (2 cups) water, bring to the boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer 15 minutes until rice is tender.

method.title: Melt and serve
method.text: Scatter shredded cheese on top, cover 2 minutes to melt. Serve with coriander or spring onions.

cheesy-taco-rice-skillet.tip: Use leftover rice to cut cooking time, or swap beef for plant-based mince for a vegetarian version.

cheesy-tomato-pasta.title: Cheesy Tomato Pasta
cheesy-tomato-pasta.subtitle: Creamy, cheesy midweek pasta

method.title: Cook pasta
method.text: Cook the pasta in a large pan of boiling salted water following the packet instructions; drain, reserving a splash of cooking water.

method.title: Soften onion
method.text: Heat the oil in a pan, soften the onion for 3–4 minutes, then add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds.

method.title: Add tomatoes
method.text: Stir in the tinned tomatoes or passata and mixed herbs, season, then simmer gently for 5 minutes.

method.title: Combine and cheese
method.text: Add the cooked pasta and most of the cheddar, toss until coated and the cheese melts; add a splash of reserved water if needed.

method.title: Finish and serve
method.text: Top with the remaining cheddar, scatter parsley if using and serve warm.

cheesy-tomato-pasta.tip: Stir in a pinch of chilli flakes or swap cheddar for mozzarella for a gooier finish.

chilli-beef-noodles.title: Chilli Beef Noodles
chilli-beef-noodles.subtitle: Quick spicy beef noodle stir-fry

method.title: Cook noodles
method.text: Boil the noodles following packet instructions. Drain and set aside.

method.title: Brown beef
method.text: Heat a large pan and cook the mince over medium heat until browned. Drain excess fat.

method.title: Add veg
method.text: Add onion, garlic, red pepper and stir-fry veg. Cook 3–4 minutes until softened.

method.title: Add sauce
method.text: Stir in the chilli & garlic sauce and soy (if using). Simmer for 2–3 minutes.

method.title: Combine & serve
method.text: Toss in the noodles, heat through, then top with sesame seeds and spring onions.

chilli-beef-noodles.tip: Use leftover or frozen veg to save time and boost your portions.

creamy-cajun-chicken-flatbreads.title: Creamy Cajun Chicken Flatbreads
creamy-cajun-chicken-flatbreads.subtitle: Spicy, creamy and packed with flavour!

method.title: Prep the chicken
method.text: Slice chicken into strips and toss with the Cajun seasoning.

method.title: Cook the chicken
method.text: Heat a little oil in a pan and fry the chicken 5–6 minutes until golden and cooked through.

method.title: Cook the veg
method.text: Add sliced red pepper and onion to the pan and cook 3–4 minutes until softened.

method.title: Make sauce
method.text: Lower the heat, add garlic and pour in the cooking cream. Simmer 2–3 minutes until slightly thickened.

method.title: Assemble & bake
method.text: Top naans with the creamy Cajun chicken, sprinkle with cheese and bake at 200°C for 5–7 minutes. Finish with parsley.

creamy-cajun-chicken-flatbreads.tip: Warm naans first for a crisper base, or swap for wraps for a lighter meal.

creamy-garlic-chicken-gnocchi.title: Creamy Garlic Chicken Gnocchi
creamy-garlic-chicken-gnocchi.subtitle: Creamy, garlicky one-pan dinner

method.title: Cook gnocchi
method.text: Bring a saucepan of salted water to the boil. Cook gnocchi until they float, 2–3 minutes. Drain and set aside.

method.title: Brown chicken
method.text: Heat oil in a frying pan. Season chicken and cook over medium heat until golden and cooked through, about 5–6 minutes.

method.title: Build sauce
method.text: Add garlic to the pan and fry 30 seconds. Pour in stock, then stir in cream cheese and most parmesan until smooth.

method.title: Wilt spinach
method.text: Stir in spinach until wilted. Season with salt, pepper and chilli flakes if using.

method.title: Combine & serve
method.text: Add gnocchi and chicken to the sauce, toss to coat. Scatter over remaining parmesan and parsley, then serve.

creamy-garlic-chicken-gnocchi.tip: Use leftover roast chicken to save time, or swap cream cheese for low-fat soft cheese for a lighter sauce.

creamy-garlic-chicken-orzo.title: Creamy Garlic Chicken Orzo
creamy-garlic-chicken-orzo.subtitle: Creamy garlicky orzo

method.title: Cook the chicken
method.text: Heat the oil in a large pan. Cook diced chicken until golden and cooked through, then remove and set aside.

method.title: Sauté onion & garlic
method.text: In the same pan, soften the onion for 2-3 minutes, then stir in the garlic for 30 seconds.

method.title: Simmer the orzo
method.text: Add the orzo and chicken stock. Simmer for 8-10 minutes, stirring often, until the orzo is tender.

method.title: Stir in cheese
method.text: Stir in the cream cheese, parmesan, Italian seasoning and the cooked chicken. Mix until creamy.

method.title: Add spinach & serve
method.text: Fold in the spinach until wilted. Season with salt and black pepper, then serve warm.

creamy-garlic-chicken-orzo.tip: Add a squeeze of lemon or a pinch of chilli flakes to brighten the dish.

creamy-garlic-chicken-pasta.title: Creamy Garlic Chicken Pasta
creamy-garlic-chicken-pasta.subtitle: Rich, creamy and ready in 20 minutes!

method.title: Cook the pasta
method.text: Bring a large pan of salted water to the boil. Cook the penne to packet instructions, drain and set aside.

method.title: Cook the chicken
method.text: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt, pepper and Italian herbs. Fry in oil until golden and cooked through.

method.title: Make the sauce
method.text: Add more oil if needed and fry the onion and garlic 2 minutes. Stir in sun dried tomatoes and cook 1 minute.

method.title: Add cream and spinach
method.text: Pour in the single cream, simmer 3–4 minutes. Add a handful of spinach and stir until wilted. Season to taste.

method.title: Combine and serve
method.text: Add cooked pasta and most of the grated cheese, toss until creamy. Top with remaining cheese, pepper and herbs to serve.

creamy-garlic-chicken-pasta.tip: Swap the chicken for prawns or use broccoli instead of spinach for a different twist!

creamy-garlic-chicken-rice.title: Creamy Garlic Chicken Rice
creamy-garlic-chicken-rice.subtitle: Creamy chicken in a garlicky sauce

method.title: Cook the rice
method.text: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions and keep warm.

method.title: Season and fry
method.text: Season chicken with salt, pepper and half the mixed herbs. Fry in a little oil 5–6 mins each side until cooked through; slice.

method.title: Make the sauce
method.text: In the same pan cook onion 3–4 mins. Add garlic and chilli for 1 min. Pour in cream, add remaining herbs and a handful of Parmesan; simmer 2–3 mins.

method.title: Add the greens
method.text: Stir in spinach until wilted, return the sliced chicken to the pan and coat in the sauce.

method.title: Serve
method.text: Serve the chicken and sauce over the rice. Top with extra Parmesan and cracked pepper.

creamy-garlic-chicken-rice.tip: Add mushrooms for extra flavour or swap the spinach for broccoli.

creamy-garlic-sausage-pasta.title: Creamy Garlic Sausage Pasta
creamy-garlic-sausage-pasta.subtitle: Quick creamy sausage comfort pasta

method.title: Cook pasta
method.text: Boil a large pan of salted water and cook the pasta to packet instructions. Reserve a splash of pasta water.

method.title: Brown sausage
method.text: Remove sausage meat from the skins and fry in a large pan with a drizzle of oil. Add chopped onion and cook 4–5 mins, then add the garlic for 1 min.

method.title: Make sauce
method.text: Stir in the cream cheese and a splash of pasta water or dissolved stock cube. Stir until it melts into a creamy sauce.

method.title: Add spinach & pasta
method.text: Add the spinach and cooked pasta to the pan. Mix until the spinach wilts and everything is well coated in the sauce.

method.title: Finish and serve
method.text: Stir through the grated cheese, season with salt and pepper, give everything a final mix and serve immediately.

creamy-garlic-sausage-pasta.tip: Add chilli flakes for an extra kick.

creamy-harissa-chicken-couscous.title: Creamy Harissa Chicken Couscous
creamy-harissa-chicken-couscous.subtitle: Spicy, creamy and full of flavour!

method.title: Season & fry
method.text: Season chicken with salt, pepper and 1 tbsp harissa. Fry in a little oil 6–8 mins until golden and cooked through, then slice.

method.title: Cook veg
method.text: In the same pan fry chopped onion and red pepper 5 mins until softened. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.

method.title: Make sauce
method.text: Stir in the remaining harissa and creme fraiche. Simmer 2–3 mins, add spinach and sliced chicken and warm through. Season to taste.

method.title: Cook couscous
method.text: Prepare the couscous according to the pack instructions, then fluff with a fork.

method.title: Serve
method.text: Spoon couscous into bowls, top with the creamy harissa chicken, squeeze over lemon and scatter chopped parsley.

creamy-harissa-chicken-couscous.tip: Add crumbled feta or a drizzle of chilli oil before serving.

creamy-lemon-chicken-orzo.title: Creamy Lemon Chicken Orzo
creamy-lemon-chicken-orzo.subtitle: Easy • Creamy • Bright & comforting

method.title: season and fry
method.text: Season the chicken with salt, pepper and mixed herbs. Fry in olive oil until golden and cooked through, then set aside.

method.title: soften the veg
method.text: In the same pan, cook the onion and garlic until softened. Stir in the orzo and cook for 1 minute.

method.title: add liquids
method.text: Pour in the chicken stock, light cream, lemon zest and juice. Bring to a gentle simmer.

method.title: simmer orzo
method.text: Simmer until the orzo is tender and the sauce has thickened, stirring occasionally.

method.title: finish and serve
method.text: Stir through spinach and parmesan, return the chicken to the pan, season to taste and serve with extra parmesan.

creamy-lemon-chicken-orzo.tip: Use leftover roast chicken to cut prep time, or add extra lemon for a brighter finish.

creamy-peri-peri-chicken-pasta.title: Creamy Peri-Peri Chicken Pasta
creamy-peri-peri-chicken-pasta.subtitle: Spicy, creamy and packed with flavour!

method.title: Cook the pasta
method.text: Cook pasta according to pack instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.

method.title: Season and fry
method.text: Cut chicken into strips, season with salt, pepper and mixed herbs. Fry in a hot pan until cooked through.

method.title: Add the veg
method.text: Add onion, red pepper and garlic to the pan. Cook 2–3 minutes until softened.

method.title: Make the sauce
method.text: Stir in peri-peri sauce, then pour in the single cream. Simmer 3–4 minutes until slightly thickened.

method.title: Combine and serve
method.text: Add pasta, spinach and half the cheese. Stir to combine, top with remaining cheese and serve.

creamy-peri-peri-chicken-pasta.tip: Add extra peri-peri to increase heat, and a squeeze of lemon to brighten the flavour.

creamy-pesto-chicken-gnocchi.title: Creamy Pesto Chicken Gnocchi
creamy-pesto-chicken-gnocchi.subtitle: Creamy, herby comfort dish

method.title: Prep chicken
method.text: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and season with salt, pepper and italian herbs.

method.title: Cook chicken
method.text: Heat a large pan with a little oil. Fry the chicken 5–6 minutes until golden and cooked through, then remove.

method.title: Fry gnocchi
method.text: Add a little more oil to the pan and fry the gnocchi 4–5 minutes until golden and slightly crispy.

method.title: Make sauce
method.text: Add minced garlic and tomatoes; cook 2–3 minutes. Lower heat, stir in pesto and double cream and simmer 2 minutes.

method.title: Finish & serve
method.text: Return chicken to the pan, stir in spinach until wilted. Top with grated cheese and a pinch of black pepper.

creamy-pesto-chicken-gnocchi.tip: Squeeze a little lemon over at the end to make the flavours pop.

creamy-sun-dried-tomato-chicken-orzo.title: Creamy Sun-Dried Tomato Chicken Orzo
creamy-sun-dried-tomato-chicken-orzo.subtitle: Creamy orzo with sun-dried tomatoes

method.title: Season & fry chicken
method.text: Season chicken with salt, pepper and Italian seasoning. Heat oil in a large pan and cook 4–5 mins until golden and cooked through. Remove.

method.title: Sauté garlic & tomatoes
method.text: In the same pan, sauté garlic 30 seconds, then add sun-dried tomatoes and cook 1–2 mins.

method.title: Cook the orzo
method.text: Add orzo and chicken stock. Simmer 8–10 mins, stirring occasionally, until the orzo is almost tender.

method.title: Stir in cheese & spinach
method.text: Stir in cream cheese, parmesan, spinach and sliced chicken. Simmer 2–3 mins until creamy and spinach wilts.

method.title: Serve & enjoy
method.text: Season to taste and serve topped with extra parmesan and fresh herbs if you like.

creamy-sun-dried-tomato-chicken-orzo.tip: Use leftover roast chicken to save time, and finish with extra parmesan or fresh basil.

creamy-tomato-chicken-pasta.title: Creamy Tomato Chicken Pasta
creamy-tomato-chicken-pasta.subtitle: Creamy, tangy chicken pasta

method.title: Cook pasta
method.text: Boil the penne in salted water until al dente, following the packet timings.

method.title: Cook chicken
method.text: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces, season with salt, pepper and Italian herbs, then fry in oil until cooked.

method.title: Make sauce
method.text: Add garlic to the pan, cook 1 minute. Add cherry tomatoes, soften, then stir in purée and cream and simmer 5–7 mins.

method.title: Combine and simmer
method.text: Add the cooked pasta and chicken to the sauce, toss together and simmer for 2 minutes to coat.

method.title: Serve and enjoy
method.text: Divide between bowls and top with grated cheese and extra herbs to serve.

creamy-tomato-chicken-pasta.tip: Stir in spinach or swap cream for crème fraîche for a tangier sauce and extra veg.

creamy-tomato-pasta.title: Creamy Tomato Pasta
creamy-tomato-pasta.subtitle: Rich, creamy, garlicky and ready in no time!

method.title: cook pasta
method.text: Cook the pasta according to the packet. Drain, reserving a splash of pasta water, and set aside.

method.title: fry onion
method.text: Heat oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Cook the onion 3–4 minutes until soft.

method.title: add garlic & paste
method.text: Stir in garlic, cook 1 minute. Add tomato purée and cook 1–2 minutes to deepen flavour.

method.title: simmer sauce
method.text: Add chopped tomatoes, herbs, chilli flakes and seasoning. Simmer 8–10 minutes until slightly reduced.

method.title: finish & serve
method.text: Stir in cream, simmer 2–3 minutes. Toss in pasta, coat with sauce and top with cheese and basil.

creamy-tomato-pasta.tip: Add a splash of pasta water or a knob of butter for extra richness.

creamy-tomato-potato-bake.title: Creamy Tomato Potato Bake
creamy-tomato-potato-bake.subtitle: Comforting creamy tomato bake

method.title: Preheat oven
method.text: Preheat oven to 200°C (gas 6). Grease a medium baking dish.

method.title: Prep potatoes
method.text: Thinly slice potatoes to 3–4mm. Toss with 1 tbsp oil, salt and pepper and microwave 5 minutes or parboil.

method.title: Make sauce
method.text: Fry chopped onion and crushed garlic in a little oil 3–4 mins. Stir in chopped tomatoes, cream and oregano; simmer 3 mins.

method.title: Assemble bake
method.text: Spread a third of sauce, layer half the potatoes, repeat and finish with grated cheddar.

method.title: Bake and serve
method.text: Bake for 10 minutes until bubbling and cheese melted. Leave 5 minutes before serving.

creamy-tomato-potato-bake.tip: Parboil or microwave the slices first for evenly cooked layers and a quicker bake.

creamy-tuscan-chicken-pasta.title: Creamy Tuscan Chicken Pasta
creamy-tuscan-chicken-pasta.subtitle: Creamy tomato & spinach pasta

method.title: Cook pasta
method.text: Bring a saucepan of salted water to the boil and cook the penne to packet instructions. Drain, reserve a little cooking water.

method.title: Cook chicken
method.text: Heat the oil in a frying pan, season the chicken and fry until golden and cooked through, about 5–6 minutes.

method.title: Make sauce
method.text: Stir in garlic and sun-dried tomatoes, add stock and soft cheese and simmer until smooth and slightly reduced.

method.title: Add greens
method.text: Add spinach and parmesan, cook until wilted then toss in the drained pasta, using reserved pasta water to loosen if needed.

method.title: Serve
method.text: Divide between plates, season to taste and finish with basil or parsley and extra parmesan if liked.

creamy-tuscan-chicken-pasta.tip: Reserve a splash of pasta water to loosen the sauce if it gets too thick.

crispy-bean-quesadillas.title: Crispy Bean Quesadillas
crispy-bean-quesadillas.subtitle: Golden, crispy and packed with melted cheese

method.title: Prep veg
method.text: Finely chop the onion and red pepper, and crush or finely chop the garlic.

method.title: Cook filling
method.text: Heat oil in a pan over medium. Fry onion and pepper for 5 minutes until softened.

method.title: Add beans
method.text: Stir in garlic and spices, cook 1 minute then add beans and tomatoes. Simmer 8–10 minutes and season.

method.title: Assemble quesadillas
method.text: Spread a spoonful of the bean mix and sprinkle cheese on a tortilla. Top with another tortilla.

method.title: Cook & serve
method.text: Fry 2–3 minutes each side until golden and cheese melts. Slice into wedges and serve with toppings.

crispy-bean-quesadillas.tip: For extra crisp, add a little more oil and press the quesadilla with a spatula while cooking.

crispy-beef-burrito-bowls.title: Crispy Beef Burrito Bowls
crispy-beef-burrito-bowls.subtitle: Bold flavours. Fresh ingredients.

method.title: Cook rice
method.text: Cook the rice according to the pack instructions.

method.title: Brown beef
method.text: Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the beef mince until browned.

method.title: Add seasoning
method.text: Stir in the taco seasoning with a splash of water and simmer 2–3 minutes.

method.title: Prep veg
method.text: Warm the beans and sweetcorn. Prep tomatoes, onion, lettuce and mash the avocado.

method.title: Assemble bowls
method.text: Divide rice between bowls. Top with beef, beans, veg, sour cream and a squeeze of lime.

crispy-beef-burrito-bowls.tip: Add jalapeños or hot sauce for extra heat, or swap sour cream for Greek yogurt to keep it lighter.

crispy-beef-taco-rice-bowls.title: Crispy Beef Taco Rice Bowls
crispy-beef-taco-rice-bowls.subtitle: Easy takeaway-style dinner at home.

method.title: Cook rice
method.text: Cook the rice according to the pack instructions, then keep warm.

method.title: Cook veg
method.text: Fry the chopped onion and red pepper in a little oil until softened.

method.title: Brown beef
method.text: Add the beef mince and cook, breaking it up, until browned all over.

method.title: Add seasonings
method.text: Stir in smoked paprika, cumin, tomato puree and sweetcorn; cook until sticky.

method.title: Assemble bowls
method.text: Divide rice between bowls, add lettuce and tomatoes, top with beef, cheese and sour cream.

crispy-beef-taco-rice-bowls.tip: For extra crunch, leave the beef undisturbed for a minute so it caramelises.

crispy-sweet-chilli-chicken-bowls.title: Crispy Sweet Chilli Chicken Bowls
crispy-sweet-chilli-chicken-bowls.subtitle: Sticky, crispy & fresh

method.title: Coat chicken
method.text: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Toss with cornflour or breadcrumbs, garlic powder, salt and pepper.

method.title: Fry chicken
method.text: Heat oil in a pan and fry the chicken for 6–8 minutes until golden and cooked through.

method.title: Stir-fry peppers
method.text: In the same pan, stir-fry the peppers for 3–4 minutes until just tender.

method.title: Add sauce
method.text: Return chicken to the pan, stir in the sweet chilli sauce and cook 1–2 minutes until sticky.

method.title: Assemble bowls
method.text: Divide rice between bowls. Top with chicken, peppers, cucumber and spring onions. Drizzle mayo and serve.

crispy-sweet-chilli-chicken-bowls.tip: Use cornflour for extra crunch or breadcrumbs for a lighter coating.

crispy-sweet-chilli-chicken-noodles.title: Crispy Sweet Chilli Chicken Noodles
crispy-sweet-chilli-chicken-noodles.subtitle: Sticky, speedy stir-fry

method.title: Prep everything
method.text: Thinly slice chicken and cut veg into thin strips. Have noodles and sauces ready.

method.title: Cook the chicken
method.text: Heat oil in a frying pan or wok. Add chicken and cook until golden and cooked through, 4–5 mins.

method.title: Stir-fry veg
method.text: Add carrot, pepper and sugar snap peas to the pan. Stir-fry for 2–3 minutes until crisp-tender.

method.title: Add noodles
method.text: Toss in the noodles, spring onions, garlic, soy and sweet chilli sauce. Stir until heated through and coated.

method.title: Finish & serve
method.text: Scatter sesame seeds (and coriander or chilli flakes if using). Serve straight from the pan.

crispy-sweet-chilli-chicken-noodles.tip: Use a hot pan and don’t overcrowd so the chicken crisps up; add coriander for freshness.

crispy-sweet-chilli-halloumi-burgers.title: Crispy Sweet Chilli Halloumi Burgers
crispy-sweet-chilli-halloumi-burgers.subtitle: Crispy halloumi with sweet chilli mayo

method.title: Prepare halloumi
method.text: Slice the halloumi into thick pieces. Coat each slice in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.

method.title: Heat the oil
method.text: Warm a little oil in a frying pan over medium heat.

method.title: Fry until golden
method.text: Fry the coated halloumi until golden and crispy, about 2–3 minutes each side.

method.title: Build the burgers
method.text: Mix mayo with a little sweet chilli. Toast buns, then layer lettuce, red onion and crispy halloumi.

method.title: Finish and serve
method.text: Drizzle extra sweet chilli sauce over the halloumi and serve immediately.

crispy-sweet-chilli-halloumi-burgers.tip: Press slices into the breadcrumbs twice for an extra-crispy coating.

garlic-butter-chicken-and-rice.title: Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice
garlic-butter-chicken-and-rice.subtitle: Creamy, garlicky and comforting

method.title: Cook rice
method.text: Cook the rice according to the pack instructions.

method.title: Season chicken
method.text: Season the chicken with salt, pepper and mixed herbs.

method.title: Fry chicken
method.text: Melt half the butter in a large pan. Fry chicken 5–6 minutes until golden and cooked; remove.

method.title: Make sauce
method.text: Add remaining butter, cook onion 2–3 minutes. Add garlic and chilli flakes 1 minute. Stir in cream and crumbled stock cube; simmer 2–3 minutes.

method.title: Combine & serve
method.text: Stir in spinach and cheese, return chicken and coat in sauce. Serve over rice.

garlic-butter-chicken-and-rice.tip: Add extra veg like broccoli or peas to bulk it out and make it more filling.

garlic-butter-chicken-flatbreads.title: Garlic-Butter Chicken Flatbreads
garlic-butter-chicken-flatbreads.subtitle: Buttery garlic chicken wraps

method.title: Prepare chicken
method.text: Slice chicken into strips, season with salt and pepper.

method.title: Make garlic butter
method.text: Melt butter with olive oil, add crushed garlic and lemon juice.

method.title: Cook chicken
method.text: Fry chicken in a hot pan until cooked through and golden, about 5–7 minutes.

method.title: Warm flatbreads
method.text: Warm flatbreads in a dry pan or oven until soft and slightly charred.

method.title: Assemble wraps
method.text: Spread garlic butter on flatbreads, add chicken, salad and parsley, squeeze over lemon.

garlic-butter-chicken-flatbreads.tip: Warm flatbreads wrapped in foil in a low oven to keep them soft and flexible.

garlic-butter-flatbreads.title: Garlic Butter Flatbreads
garlic-butter-flatbreads.subtitle: Golden garlicky flatbreads

method.title: Make garlic butter
method.text: Melt the butter, then stir in minced garlic, chopped parsley, dried herbs, salt and pepper.

method.title: Prepare flatbreads
method.text: Lay the naans on a baking tray and brush or spoon the garlic butter evenly over each one.

method.title: Add cheese
method.text: Sprinkle with grated hard cheese and a little extra dried herbs if you like.

method.title: Bake until golden
method.text: Bake at 200°C for 6–8 minutes, or until the edges are golden and crisp.

method.title: Slice and serve
method.text: Slice and serve hot as a side, snack or alongside your favourite meal.

garlic-butter-flatbreads.tip: For crisp edges, grill for 1 minute at the end; wrap to keep soft if serving later.

garlic-butter-halloumi-couscous.title: Garlic Butter Halloumi Couscous
garlic-butter-halloumi-couscous.subtitle: Zesty garlic halloumi couscous

method.title: Prepare couscous
method.text: Pour 200ml boiling water over the couscous, cover and leave 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.

method.title: Fry halloumi
method.text: Cut halloumi into cubes. Fry in a little olive oil over medium-high heat 2–3 minutes each side until golden.

method.title: Make garlic butter
method.text: Lower the heat, add the butter and minced garlic to the pan and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.

method.title: Combine and serve
method.text: Toss couscous with garlic butter, halloumi, tomatoes, cucumber, onion, lemon juice and parsley. Season and serve.

garlic-butter-halloumi-couscous.tip: Swap parsley for mint or add chilli flakes for extra freshness and heat.

garlic-butter-sausage-pasta.title: Garlic Butter Sausage Pasta
garlic-butter-sausage-pasta.subtitle: Creamy garlic butter pasta

method.title: Cook pasta
method.text: Cook pasta in boiling salted water following packet instructions. Reserve a little pasta water.

method.title: Fry sausages
method.text: Fry sausages in olive oil over medium heat until browned and cooked through. Remove and keep warm.

method.title: Sauté onion & garlic
method.text: In the same pan, soften the onion 3–4 minutes; add garlic and butter and cook until fragrant.

method.title: Combine & toss
method.text: Return sausages to the pan, add drained pasta, a splash of pasta water and parmesan; toss to coat.

method.title: Season & serve
method.text: Season with salt, black pepper and chilli flakes if using. Finish with chopped parsley and serve.

garlic-butter-sausage-pasta.tip: Reserve a little pasta water to make the sauce glossy and help the cheese cling to the pasta.

garlic-butter-sausage-veggie-skillet.title: Garlic Butter Sausage & Veggie Skillet
garlic-butter-sausage-veggie-skillet.subtitle: Simple. Hearty. So good.

method.title: Par-cook potatoes
method.text: Par-cook the potatoes until just tender, then drain and set aside.

method.title: Brown the sausage
method.text: Slice the sausage and brown in a large skillet with the oil until golden.

method.title: Add veg & butter
method.text: Add potatoes, peppers, onion, garlic, butter and Italian seasoning to the skillet.

method.title: Crisp and cook
method.text: Cook, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are golden and the veg is tender.

method.title: Season and serve
method.text: Season with salt and black pepper to taste and serve hot.

garlic-butter-sausage-veggie-skillet.tip: Par-cook potatoes in the microwave to save time, then crisp them in the skillet.

garlic-parmesan-chicken-flatbreads.title: Garlic Parmesan Chicken Flatbreads
garlic-parmesan-chicken-flatbreads.subtitle: Cheesy, garlicky fakeaway

method.title: Season chicken
method.text: Mix chicken with garlic granules, Italian seasoning, salt and pepper.

method.title: Cook chicken
method.text: Heat oil in a frying pan and cook the chicken until golden and cooked through.

method.title: Assemble flatbreads
method.text: Spread garlic and herb soft cheese over the flatbreads, then top with mozzarella, chicken and parmesan.

method.title: Bake or air-fry
method.text: Bake or air-fry until the flatbreads are crisp and the cheese is melted and bubbly.

method.title: Finish and serve
method.text: Scatter chopped parsley over the flatbreads, slice and serve hot.

garlic-parmesan-chicken-flatbreads.tip: Drizzle garlic mayo over the flatbreads after cooking for extra fakeaway flavour.

garlic-sausage-rice-bowls.title: Garlic Sausage Rice Bowls
garlic-sausage-rice-bowls.subtitle: Juicy sausages, garlicky rice & roasted veg

method.title: Cook rice
method.text: Cook the rice according to the pack instructions; keep covered and warm.

method.title: Fry sausages
method.text: Heat oil in a large frying pan over medium. Cook sausages 10–12 mins, turning, until cooked through. Remove and slice.

method.title: Cook veg
method.text: In the same pan, cook onion and pepper 5–6 mins until soft. Add garlic and cook 1 minute.

method.title: Combine and simmer
method.text: Return sausages to the pan. Add peas, mixed herbs and chilli flakes. Stir in crème fraîche and simmer 2–3 mins. Season.

method.title: Serve
method.text: Divide rice between bowls, spoon over the sausage mixture and top with grated cheese and extra herbs.

garlic-sausage-rice-bowls.tip: Add a squeeze of lemon or extra herbs for more flavour!

honey-chilli-chicken-noodles.title: Honey Chilli Chicken Noodles
honey-chilli-chicken-noodles.subtitle: Quick takeaway-style noodles at home.

method.title: Cook noodles
method.text: Cook noodles to packet instructions, drain and reserve a little cooking water.

method.title: Cook chicken
method.text: Heat oil in a frying pan or wok and fry the chicken until golden and cooked through.

method.title: Add veg & garlic
method.text: Add red pepper, spring onions and garlic; cook for 2–3 minutes until just softened.

method.title: Add sauces
method.text: Stir in sweet chilli, honey, soy and chilli flakes, then add the noodles and toss well.

method.title: Finish and serve
method.text: Mix until glossy and hot, loosen with reserved noodle water if needed, then scatter sesame seeds.

honey-chilli-chicken-noodles.tip: Add a splash of reserved noodle water to loosen the sauce so it coats every strand.

honey-soy-beef-noodles.title: Honey Soy Beef Noodles
honey-soy-beef-noodles.subtitle: Sweet, savoury and speedy

method.title: Cook noodles
method.text: Bring a large pan of water to the boil and cook the egg noodles to packet instructions. Drain and set aside.

method.title: Brown the beef
method.text: Heat a wok or large frying pan over medium-high. Add beef mince and cook until browned, breaking it up. Drain excess fat if needed.

method.title: Add veg
method.text: Add sliced onion and red pepper and cook 3–4 minutes until softened. Stir in minced garlic and cook 1 minute more.

method.title: Mix sauce
method.text: Whisk soy sauce, honey and sesame oil in a small bowl. Pour into the pan and simmer 2–3 minutes until slightly thickened.

method.title: Toss and serve
method.text: Add the cooked noodles and toss until well coated. Top with sliced spring onions and sesame seeds, then serve.

honey-soy-beef-noodles.tip: Swap beef for shredded chicken or tofu to save money and vary the dish.

honey-soy-sausage-noodle-bowls.title: Honey Soy Sausage Noodle Bowls
honey-soy-sausage-noodle-bowls.subtitle: Sticky honey-soy noodle bowls

method.title: cook sausages
method.text: Cook sausages in a pan or oven until browned and cooked through, then slice.

method.title: cook noodles
method.text: Cook the noodles according to the packet instructions, then drain.

method.title: fry pepper
method.text: Heat the oil, fry the red pepper for 2–3 minutes, then add the sliced sausages.

method.title: add sauces
method.text: Stir in soy sauce, honey, sweet chilli and garlic paste until everything is sticky and coated.

method.title: combine & serve
method.text: Toss in the noodles and spring onions, divide into bowls and top with sesame seeds.

honey-soy-sausage-noodle-bowls.tip: Bulk it out with shredded cabbage or extra veg to stretch portions and add crunch.

hot-honey-chicken-flatbread-pizzas.title: Hot Honey Chicken Flatbread Pizzas
hot-honey-chicken-flatbread-pizzas.subtitle: Sweet heat. Juicy chicken. Seriously good.

method.title: Prep the chicken
method.text: If raw, fry in olive oil with minced garlic, smoked paprika, salt and pepper until cooked, then shred. If cooked, toss with hot honey, garlic and paprika.

method.title: Prep the toppings
method.text: Thinly slice the red onion and jalapeños, grate the mozzarella and chop the coriander.

method.title: Assemble flatbreads
method.text: Lay flatbreads on a baking tray. Top with the honey chicken, mozzarella, red onion and jalapeños.

method.title: Bake
method.text: Bake in a hot oven 200°C (fan 180°C) for 8–10 minutes until the cheese has melted and started to brown.

method.title: Finish & serve
method.text: Drizzle with extra hot honey, scatter coriander and a pinch of chilli flakes if you like. Slice and serve hot.

hot-honey-chicken-flatbread-pizzas.tip: Use leftover roast chicken to make this even quicker — perfect for turning leftovers into something epic!

loaded-bbq-beef-nachos.title: Loaded BBQ Beef Nachos
loaded-bbq-beef-nachos.subtitle: Smoky, cheesy BBQ nachos

method.title: Cook the beef
method.text: Heat a frying pan and brown the beef mince with smoked paprika, seasoning to taste.

method.title: Add the sauce
method.text: Stir in the BBQ sauce and simmer for 1–2 minutes until the beef is glossy and saucy.

method.title: Layer the chips
method.text: Scatter tortilla chips on a baking tray or ovenproof dish and top evenly with the beef, red onion and jalapeño.

method.title: Melt the cheese
method.text: Sprinkle over the grated cheese and place under a hot grill or in a 200°C oven for 3–5 minutes until melted.

method.title: Finish & serve
method.text: Top with sour cream, sliced spring onion and coriander if using. Serve immediately so chips stay crisp.

loaded-bbq-beef-nachos.tip: Use pickled jalapeños for extra tang and serve straight from the oven so the chips stay crisp.

loaded-taco-jacket-potato.title: Loaded Taco Jacket Potato
loaded-taco-jacket-potato.subtitle: Crispy jacket potato. Zesty taco filling. All your favourite toppings.

method.title: Bake potatoes
method.text: Heat oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Scrub, prick and rub potatoes with oil and salt. Bake 50–60 minutes until crisp and fluffy.

method.title: Fry onion & garlic
method.text: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat. Cook onion 3–4 minutes until soft, add garlic and cook 1 minute.

method.title: Brown the beef
method.text: Add minced beef, break up with a spoon and cook until browned. Drain excess fat if needed.

method.title: Season & simmer
method.text: Stir in taco seasoning and 100ml water. Simmer 5–10 minutes until thick and well flavoured.

method.title: Assemble & serve
method.text: Cut potatoes open, fluff the insides and spoon over beef. Top with cheese, lettuce, tomato and sour cream to serve.

loaded-taco-jacket-potato.tip: Swap beef for black beans or lentils for a veg option; add crushed tortilla chips for extra crunch.

one-pan-smoky-beef-orzo.title: One-Pan Smoky Beef Orzo
one-pan-smoky-beef-orzo.subtitle: Big flavour. Minimal effort. Perfect for busy nights!

method.title: Brown the beef
method.text: Heat a large deep pan over medium-high. Add beef mince and cook until browned, breaking it up. Drain excess fat if needed.

method.title: Cook the veg
method.text: Add red onion and red pepper and cook 3–4 minutes until softened. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.

method.title: Add spices & orzo
method.text: Stir in smoked paprika, then add orzo, tinned tomatoes and 500ml water (or stock made with the beef stock cubes). Season.

method.title: Simmer gently
method.text: Bring to a gentle boil, reduce to medium and simmer 12–15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until orzo is tender and sauce has thickened.

method.title: Finish & serve
method.text: Stir in spinach until wilted, top with cheddar and cover for a couple of minutes to melt. Serve straight from the pan.

one-pan-smoky-beef-orzo.tip: Add a pinch of chilli flakes for extra kick or swap the spinach for kale!

one-pan-tomato-chicken-orzo.title: One-Pan Tomato Chicken Orzo
one-pan-tomato-chicken-orzo.subtitle: Creamy tomato chicken orzo

method.title: Brown the chicken
method.text: Heat a large deep pan with oil. Season chicken and cook until golden on both sides. Remove and set aside.

method.title: Add onion and garlic
method.text: Add chopped onion and cook 3–4 mins until softened. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.

method.title: Add orzo and liquids
method.text: Return chicken to the pan. Stir in orzo, tinned tomatoes, chicken stock and italian seasoning. Season to taste.

method.title: Simmer until tender
method.text: Bring to a gentle simmer, cover and cook 15–20 mins, stirring occasionally, until the orzo is tender and most liquid absorbed.

method.title: Finish and serve
method.text: Stir through cream cheese and spinach until wilted and creamy. Taste and adjust seasoning, then serve immediately.

one-pan-tomato-chicken-orzo.tip: Finish with grated cheese or fresh basil for extra flavour.

sticky-bbq-beef-rice-bowls.title: Sticky BBQ Beef Rice Bowls
sticky-bbq-beef-rice-bowls.subtitle: Quick sticky beef with rice

method.title: Cook the rice
method.text: Cook rice to packet instructions, or microwave pouches, then keep warm.

method.title: Brown the beef
method.text: Heat oil in a large frying pan and cook beef mince until browned.

method.title: Add veg
method.text: Stir in sliced red pepper and garlic and cook 2–3 minutes until softened.

method.title: Make it sticky
method.text: Add BBQ sauce, soy, honey and paprika. Simmer 2 minutes until glossy.

method.title: Serve
method.text: Spoon beef over rice and top with sliced spring onions and sesame seeds.

sticky-bbq-beef-rice-bowls.tip: Use microwave rice pouches to save time, or add chilli flakes for a spicy kick.

sticky-bbq-chicken-rice-bowls.title: Sticky BBQ Chicken Rice Bowls
sticky-bbq-chicken-rice-bowls.subtitle: Sticky BBQ chicken with fluffy rice

method.title: Cook the rice
method.text: Cook rice in boiling salted water according to pack instructions. Drain and keep warm.

method.title: Fry the chicken
method.text: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and fry in a large pan with a little oil until cooked through, 8–10 mins.

method.title: Add the veg
method.text: Add chopped onion, pepper and crushed garlic to the pan and cook for 4–5 mins until softened.

method.title: Make it sticky
method.text: Stir in the BBQ sauce, soy sauce and honey. Simmer 3–5 mins until sauce is thick and glossy, coating the chicken.

method.title: Serve
method.text: Spoon the chicken and sauce over the rice and finish with sliced spring onions.

sticky-bbq-chicken-rice-bowls.tip: Add chilli flakes for extra heat.

sticky-beef-noodles.title: Sticky Beef Noodles
sticky-beef-noodles.subtitle: Sweet, sticky stir‑fry

method.title: Cook noodles
method.text: Cook the noodles to pack instructions, drain and set aside.

method.title: Brown beef
method.text: Heat the oil in a hot pan and cook the beef strips until browned.

method.title: Add veg
method.text: Add garlic and red pepper and cook for 2–3 minutes until just softened.

method.title: Toss with sauce
method.text: Stir in soy, hoisin, sweet chilli and honey, then add noodles and toss until glossy.

method.title: Finish & serve
method.text: Scatter spring onions and sesame seeds, season to taste and serve.

sticky-beef-noodles.tip: Stir in frozen peas or shredded cabbage with the peppers for extra veg and colour.

sticky-beef-rice-bowls.title: Sticky Beef Rice Bowls
sticky-beef-rice-bowls.subtitle: Simple ingredients. Huge flavour.

method.title: Cook rice
method.text: Cook rice according to packet instructions.

method.title: Brown the mince
method.text: Heat a large frying pan and cook the beef mince until browned. Drain any excess fat.

method.title: Add veg & garlic
method.text: Add diced red pepper, stir-fry veg and crushed garlic. Cook for 3–5 minutes until softened.

method.title: Add sauce & serve
method.text: Stir in soy sauce, honey and sesame oil. Simmer 2–3 minutes. Serve over rice and top with spring onions.

sticky-beef-rice-bowls.tip: Make extra sauce and toss through rice for saucier bowls.

sticky-chicken-loaded-fries.title: Sticky Chicken Loaded Fries
sticky-chicken-loaded-fries.subtitle: Sweet, sticky, crispy and unreal!

method.title: Cook chips
method.text: Preheat oven and cook chips according to pack instructions until crispy.

method.title: Prepare chicken
method.text: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and season with salt and pepper.

method.title: Pan-fry chicken
method.text: Heat a little oil and cook chicken over medium-high until golden and cooked through.

method.title: Add veg & sauce
method.text: Add garlic and red pepper, cook 2–3 mins. Stir in soy, sweet chilli, honey and ketchup, simmer until sticky.

method.title: Assemble & finish
method.text: Pile chips on plates, top with sticky chicken, scatter spring onions and sesame seeds to finish.

sticky-chicken-loaded-fries.tip: Drizzle sriracha or mayo on top for extra flavour.

sticky-garlic-beef-loaded-fries.title: Sticky Garlic Beef Loaded Fries
sticky-garlic-beef-loaded-fries.subtitle: Cheesy, sticky garlic beef fries

method.title: Cook the fries
method.text: Bake or air-fry the frozen fries until golden and crispy, following pack instructions.

method.title: Fry the beef
method.text: Heat a pan, cook beef strips until browned. Add garlic and stir for 30–60 seconds.

method.title: Make the sauce
method.text: Stir in soy, honey, sweet chilli and sesame oil. Cook until the beef is sticky and coated.

method.title: Assemble and serve
method.text: Pile fries on a plate, scatter over cheese, spoon sticky beef on top and finish with spring onions and sesame seeds.

sticky-garlic-beef-loaded-fries.tip: Use ready-grated cheese and oven-bake the fries for extra crispiness.

sticky-hoisin-beef-flatbreads.title: Sticky Hoisin Beef Flatbreads
sticky-hoisin-beef-flatbreads.subtitle: Quick, easy and packed with flavour!

method.title: Cook the beef
method.text: Fry the mince in a large pan over medium-high heat until browned. Add minced garlic and cook 1 minute.

method.title: Make the sauce
method.text: Stir in hoisin sauce, soy sauce and a splash of water. Simmer 5-7 minutes until thick and glossy.

method.title: Prep the veg
method.text: Thinly slice the red onion and cucumber, grate the carrots and chop the coriander.

method.title: Warm the breads
method.text: Heat flatbreads in a dry pan or in the oven a few minutes until warm and slightly crisp.

method.title: Assemble
method.text: Top each flatbread with sticky beef, fresh veg, coriander and sesame seeds. Add extra hoisin or mayo if liked.

sticky-hoisin-beef-flatbreads.tip: Swap the beef for chicken or Quorn mince for a cheaper option that's just as tasty!

sticky-honey-garlic-chicken-rice-bowls.title: Sticky Honey Garlic Chicken Rice Bowls
sticky-honey-garlic-chicken-rice-bowls.subtitle: Quick sticky chicken bowls

method.title: Cook the rice
method.text: Rinse the rice and cook according to pack instructions. Keep warm.

method.title: Make the sauce
method.text: Mix honey, soy sauce and ketchup in a small bowl. Set aside.

method.title: Fry the chicken
method.text: Heat oil in a large frying pan or wok over medium-high. Cook chicken 6–8 minutes until golden.

method.title: Add garlic & sauce
method.text: Stir in garlic for 1 minute, then pour in the sauce. Simmer 2–3 minutes until sticky and glossy.

method.title: Serve and finish
method.text: Divide rice between bowls, top with the sticky chicken and finish with spring onions and sesame seeds.

sticky-honey-garlic-chicken-rice-bowls.tip: Use chicken thighs for extra juiciness and flavour – they're often cheaper and stay tender!

sticky-honey-garlic-sausage-rice.title: Sticky Honey Garlic Sausage Bowls
sticky-honey-garlic-sausage-rice.subtitle: sweet, sticky and supper-ready

method.title: Cook rice
method.text: Heat the microwave jasmine rice according to pack instructions.

method.title: Brown sausages
method.text: Slice sausages and fry in a little olive oil over medium-high until golden and caramelised. Remove.

method.title: Stir-fry veg
method.text: In the same pan, stir-fry broccoli and red pepper for 4–5 minutes until tender-crisp.

method.title: Make sauce
method.text: Whisk together honey, soy sauce and minced garlic in a small bowl.

method.title: Combine & serve
method.text: Return sausages to the pan, pour in the sauce and simmer 2–3 minutes. Serve over rice with spring onions and sesame seeds.

sticky-honey-garlic-sausage-rice.tip: Add chilli flakes for heat or swap honey for maple syrup to vary the flavour.

sticky-korean-bbq-chicken-loaded-fries.title: Sticky Korean BBQ Chicken Loaded Fries
sticky-korean-bbq-chicken-loaded-fries.subtitle: Takeaway vibes for a fraction of the price

method.title: Cook the chips
method.text: Cook the chips according to pack instructions until golden and crispy.

method.title: Make the sauce
method.text: Mix gochujang, soy sauce, honey, garlic granules and ginger in a bowl.

method.title: Cook the chicken
method.text: Fry diced chicken in a pan over medium-high heat until cooked through, about 6–8 minutes.

method.title: Simmer in sauce
method.text: Pour the sauce over the chicken and simmer 3–4 minutes until sticky and coated.

method.title: Assemble & finish
method.text: Pile chips on plates, top with the sticky chicken and scatter spring onions, sesame and mayo.

sticky-korean-bbq-chicken-loaded-fries.tip: Add a pinch of chilli flakes for extra heat or swap the chicken for crispy tofu.

sticky-korean-beef-rice-bowls.title: Sticky Korean Beef Rice Bowls
sticky-korean-beef-rice-bowls.subtitle: sticky, sweet Korean-style beef

method.title: Prepare rice & veg
method.text: Heat the rice in the microwave as per pouch. Slice the cucumber, peel the carrot into ribbons and slice spring onions.

method.title: Brown the mince
method.text: Heat oil in a frying pan. Add beef mince and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon.

method.title: Add sauce
method.text: Stir in soy, sweet chilli, honey, garlic and ginger. Simmer for a few minutes until the mix is glossy and sticky.

method.title: Assemble bowls
method.text: Divide rice between bowls, top with beef and veg. Scatter sesame and spring onions. Add chilli flakes if you like heat.

sticky-korean-beef-rice-bowls.tip: Use leftover rice for quick lunches. Add chilli flakes to taste for extra heat.

sticky-maple-sausage-traybake.title: Sticky Maple Sausage Traybake
sticky-maple-sausage-traybake.subtitle: Sweet, savoury and packed with flavour!

method.title: Prep the veg
method.text: Heat oven to 200°C (fan 180°C). Chop potatoes, red pepper and red onion into chunks and spread on a large baking tray.

method.title: Make the glaze
method.text: Stir together maple syrup, soy sauce, minced garlic, mixed herbs, a drizzle of olive oil and seasoning in a small bowl.

method.title: Add everything
method.text: Nestle the sausages among the veg, pour over the glaze and toss so everything is well coated.

method.title: Cook in oven
method.text: Roast for 30 minutes, turning halfway, until sausages are golden and the veg is tender and caramelised.

method.title: Serve and enjoy
method.text: Spoon onto plates, drizzle over any extra glaze and sprinkle with fresh herbs if you have them.

sticky-maple-sausage-traybake.tip: Add a pinch of chilli flakes or swap the potatoes for sweet potatoes for extra flavour.

sticky-teriyaki-sausage-rice-bowls.title: Sticky Teriyaki Sausage Rice Bowls
sticky-teriyaki-sausage-rice-bowls.subtitle: Sweet sticky sausages with rice

method.title: Cook rice
method.text: Cook the rice according to the pack instructions.

method.title: Brown sausages
method.text: Heat the oil in a large frying pan. Fry the sausages until browned and cooked through.

method.title: Add veg
method.text: Add the peppers and garlic and cook for 3–4 minutes until softened.

method.title: Glaze sausages
method.text: Stir in the teriyaki and soy sauce, add a splash of water if needed and simmer to glaze.

method.title: Finish & serve
method.text: Serve the sticky sausages over the rice. Scatter spring onions and sesame seeds to finish.

sticky-teriyaki-sausage-rice-bowls.tip: Use a microwave rice pouch to get this on the table even faster.

sweet-chilli-beef-noodles.title: Sweet Chilli Beef Noodles
sweet-chilli-beef-noodles.subtitle: Quick sticky chilli noodles

method.title: Prep veg & noodles
method.text: Slice red pepper, grate carrot, chop spring onions and crush garlic. Cover noodles with boiling water to soften.

method.title: Brown the mince
method.text: Heat oil in a large frying pan, add beef mince and cook until browned, breaking it up, about 4–5 minutes.

method.title: Stir in veg
method.text: Add red pepper, carrot and garlic to the pan and stir-fry 2–3 minutes until softened.

method.title: Add sauces
method.text: Pour in sweet chilli and soy sauce, stir well and simmer 1–2 minutes so the flavours combine.

method.title: Combine & serve
method.text: Drain noodles, add to the pan with spring onions and toss to coat. Divide between bowls and serve hot.

sweet-chilli-beef-noodles.tip: Stretch the meal with frozen peas or extra veg, and use spring onion whites in cooking for extra flavour.

sweet-chilli-chicken-noodles.title: Sweet Chilli Chicken Noodles
sweet-chilli-chicken-noodles.subtitle: Sticky sweet chilli stir-fry

method.title: Cook the noodles
method.text: Cook noodles according to pack instructions. Drain and set aside.

method.title: Prepare the chicken
method.text: Slice chicken into thin strips and season with salt and pepper.

method.title: Fry the chicken
method.text: Heat a little oil in a large pan or wok. Stir-fry chicken 5–6 minutes until cooked and golden. Remove.

method.title: Stir-fry veg & sauce
method.text: Add oil, fry garlic and ginger 30s, add peppers and carrot 3–4 minutes. Stir in sweet chilli and soy, simmer 1 minute.

method.title: Combine and serve
method.text: Return chicken and noodles to the pan, toss to coat in the sauce. Top with spring onions and sesame seeds to serve.

sweet-chilli-chicken-noodles.tip: Add a squeeze of lime or a pinch of chilli flakes for extra heat!

sweet-chilli-chicken-rice-bowl.title: Sweet Chilli Chicken Rice Bowl
sweet-chilli-chicken-rice-bowl.subtitle: Sticky sweet chilli chicken bowl

method.title: Cook the rice
method.text: Rinse rice, then cook according to the packet instructions (10–12 mins). Set aside.

method.title: Prepare the chicken
method.text: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt, pepper and crushed garlic. Fry in a drizzle of oil until cooked through.

method.title: Add the veg
method.text: Add sliced red pepper, broccoli and carrot. Stir-fry 4–5 minutes until tender but still crisp.

method.title: Add the sauce
method.text: Pour in sweet chilli sauce and a splash of soy. Stir and simmer 2–3 minutes until everything is coated.

method.title: Serve and finish
method.text: Divide rice between bowls, top with chicken and veg. Finish with sliced spring onions and sesame seeds.

sweet-chilli-chicken-rice-bowl.tip: For extra flavour, marinate the chicken in a little sweet chilli for 10 minutes before cooking.

sweet-chilli-halloumi-wraps.title: Sweet Chilli Halloumi Wraps
sweet-chilli-halloumi-wraps.subtitle: Crispy halloumi with sweet chilli

method.title: Cook the halloumi
method.text: Slice halloumi into thick strips and fry in a little oil over medium heat until golden all over.

method.title: Prep the veg
method.text: Grate the carrot and slice the cucumber. Tear or shred the lettuce.

method.title: Warm the wraps
method.text: Heat wraps in a dry frying pan for 30 seconds each side or microwave until soft and pliable.

method.title: Fill the wraps
method.text: Layer lettuce, grated carrot, cucumber and golden halloumi. Drizzle sweet chilli sauce and mayo or yoghurt if using.

method.title: Roll and serve
method.text: Fold in the sides, roll up tightly and serve straight away.

sweet-chilli-halloumi-wraps.tip: Add a squeeze of lime for extra freshness.
